sections.heading: What Our Engine Supply & Fit Service Involves

blocks.html: We handle the complete engine replacement process – from sourcing the correct replacement unit to final road testing. Our service includes:

items: **Compatibility verification** – matching the engine to your vehicle's VIN, chassis code, and specification.
**Secure sourcing** – using verified engines with documented history and serial numbers.
**Full removal and fitting** – including all ancillaries, mounts, and fluids.
**ECU coding and integration** – using Mercedes-Benz Xentry/Star Diagnosis for proper programming.
**Post-installation testing** – oil pressure checks, leak testing, and road tests.
**12-month unlimited mileage warranty** – covering parts and labour.

blocks.html: We never supply engines without fitting – every unit is installed by our experienced technicians at our Essex workshop.
Because every engine and vehicle is different, we provide a fixed-price quote after we've matched the correct unit to your car. Contact us for a no-obligation estimate.

steps.title: Compatibility & Sourcing
steps.body: We verify your vehicle's VIN, chassis, and engine code to source the correct replacement unit. We only use units with verifiable history.

steps.title: Preparation & Removal
steps.body: Drain all fluids, disconnect all systems, and safely remove the old engine using proper hoisting and lifting equipment.

steps.title: Component Transfer & Fitting
steps.body: Transfer ancillaries, mounts, and wiring harnesses to the replacement unit. Install the new engine with correct torque settings and alignment.

steps.title: ECU Programming & Integration
steps.body: We use Mercedes-Benz Xentry/Star Diagnosis to code the ECU, match immobiliser data, and calibrate sensors for seamless operation.

steps.title: Testing & Quality Control
steps.body: We prime the oil system, start the engine, check oil pressure, look for leaks, run diagnostics, and perform a thorough road test.

steps.title: Handover & Warranty
steps.body: We explain the work done and provide a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty covering parts and labour. We're here for any follow-up questions.

blocks.html: Use our quick lookup to get started – we'll confirm your engine type and provide a tailored quote.

items.q: What is included in your engine supply and fit service?
items.a: We source the correct replacement engine, match it to your vehicle, remove the old unit, install the new engine with all ancillaries, program the ECU, and perform full testing – all covered by our 12-month warranty.

items.q: How long does the whole process take?
items.a: Typically 3-5 working days from arrival at our workshop, depending on parts availability and any unforeseen complications.

items.q: Do you supply engines without fitting?
items.a: No – we only offer supply and fit as a complete service. This ensures correct installation, coding, and warranty coverage.

items.q: Will my engine be matched to my specific vehicle?
items.a: Yes. We verify your VIN, chassis code, and engine number to source a unit that is fully compatible with your Mercedes-Benz.
All our supply and fit work comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty covering parts and labour.
Yes – we offer nationwide recovery from £70 (separate charge). We can arrange collection and delivery back to you.
